svg.text: Figure C — Paired per-block effect of fan 4 → fan 1 on safety
One dot per (seed × scenario) block, n = 15, 2 trials each. x = change in successful episodes within that block. Exact two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank.
Δ successful episodes in block (fan 1 − fan 4)
Black bar = mean Δ with 95 % bootstrap CI (20 000 paired block resamples). Only the two untightened DPCC arms and the two AlphaFlow -c arms clear α = 0.05.
The tightened DPCC loss (−2/30) sits far below this design's minimum detectable effect (~8/30 at 80 % power) — it is unresolved, not absent.
